flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No code for the refund decision. Only the ocms_refund_notice record exists (ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsRefundNotice, create + refundnoticelist controller) without status/decision/remarks columns. The Refund/approval Epic46 pages in ocmsadminui/src/App.tsx are inside a comment block. The only gateway integration is UraPgServiceImpl (ocmsadminprivateapi), AXS payment reconciliation, not refunds.
note: Story status is 'No requirement' in stories.json (the requirement is not given); traced as a normal story. None of the five steps has code: the cancel/proceed decision, remarks, routing to the 2OIC, triggering the refund with Payment Gateway, and triggering Cumulus. What exists is the automatically created refund record (see OCMS46.1) and the commented-out Epic46 Refund pages. Maintenance tickets touching refunds (OCMS-SR-2026-112, OCMS-SR-2026-190, OCMS-DF-2026-075) only concern refund id creation and the Exception report, so they do not change this verdict. Payment Gateway, Cumulus and the 2OIC: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Do not claim. The whole decision flow, 2OIC approval and refund triggers are not in the code.

steps.step: The officer chooses a decision (cancel refund advice / proceed with refund) on the work item
steps.detail: There is no decision field or endpoint. The OcmsRefundNotice entity (lines 19-62) has no status/decision column, and the controller only has POST /refundnotice (generic CRUD create, OcmsRefundNoticeController.java:43) and POST /refundnoticelist (line 76); there is no update or approve/cancel action. The Epic46 refund UI pages are at App.tsx:343-358 but inside a comment block (up to line 371), and the pages/epic46 folder does not exist. A grep for proceed refund, cancel refund and refund decision in ocmsadminui and ocmsadminapi: 0 results.

steps.step: The officer enters remarks for the decision
steps.detail: The refund entity only has payment data columns and refund_reason (3 characters: DBP/OVP/PSR/APP, SystemConstant.java:212-217), which is the reason the system created the refund. There is no remarks column and no refund remarks input form in ocmsadminui.

steps.step: The decision is routed to the 2OIC for approval
steps.detail: There is no approval routing. The refund/approval/:notice_num route is at App.tsx:353-358 but inside a comment block (ending at line 371). The REFUND_APPROVAL meta ('Payment Refund Approval') is only registered in Payment.ts:47-50 with path null, and only the CASH meta is used by a page (PaymentCash.tsx:424-428); no route or page uses REFUND_APPROVAL. The term 2OIC does not appear in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi or ocmsadminui, and api-authorization.properties has no refund approval role mapping.

steps.step: OCMS triggers the refund process with Payment Gateway
steps.detail: There is no refund call to Payment Gateway. The only gateway integration is UraPgServiceImpl.sendAxsTransactions (line 113), which sends AXS payment transactions to ura.paymentgateway Recon/insertOcmsAxsTxn (application-prod.properties:106-107): that is incoming payment reconciliation, not a refund. A grep for paynow and refund in the uraPg module: 0 results. The Payment Gateway side: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS triggers the refund process with Cumulus
steps.detail: There is no Cumulus interface. The word cumulus does not appear in the six repos; there is no client, cron or refund export. The ocmsadminprivateapi entity ends at line 62 with no sent-status. Same as OCMS46.6 step 1.
